auth: independent HTTPS rpcd session, memory only

traffic_history.scope: local trailing 24 hours, RAM only, not quota

guest_wifi.activation: explicit manual configuration, subsequent manual reboot

native_dashboard.provider: OEM read adapters + shared OpenWrt runtime

mac_access_control.scope: LAN to WAN, not router management

pppoe.scope: Ethernet WAN profile creation/edit via direct authenticated HTTPS RPC, discovery and scoped connection controls; no LTE reset
pppoe.limitations: Credential character subset, existing PPPoE to DHCP/static transition, physical port mapping and actual session acceptance pending

ddns.scope: preconfigured profile status and startup toggle; DNS lookup is not proof of provider update

sqm.scope: Create/edit disabled interface queue; separate opt-in activation; offload conflict guard

original_network_forms.scope: LAN, DHCP/static WAN, DHCP pool, single reservation deletion
original_network_forms.activation: LAN/WAN saved for manual activation; DHCP uses existing native rollback

forwarding_ttl.limitations: fw4 and kernel compatibility, packet verification and original OEM form pending

managed_acl.scope: Eight owned LAN-to-WAN deny slots; create/edit/toggle/delete; no global switch
managed_acl.limitations: Native read and invalid write fixture passed; live rule application and original OEM form pending

wifi_uplink.scope: Optional WPA2 STA profile on existing compatible WWAN DHCP, save disabled and separately enable at manual activation
wifi_uplink.limitations: Topology fixture passed; native write, WWAN provisioning, actual connectivity and AP coexistence pending

parental_schedule.scope: Optional per-device same-day UTC deny schedule; eight slots; no global switch
parental_schedule.limitations: Schedule validation fixture only; actual time-based rule enforcement and established flow behavior pending

openvpn_startup.scope: Existing certificate-based native client only; explicit startup toggle
openvpn_startup.limitations: Optional package absent from base image; no import or live tunnel verification

smb_inventory.provider: Linux process and OpenWrt service inventory
smb_inventory.scope: Read only; no password disclosure or share management

optional_tunnel_inventory.scope: Existing named N2N and Shadowsocks DNS/redirect/tunnel public profile inventory; no credentials or mutation
optional_tunnel_inventory.limitations: Package availability, native runtime and OEM original form compatibility pending

mesh_inventory.scope: Passive mesh interface and observed station counts
mesh_inventory.limitations: No mesh provisioning or connectivity proof

manual_reboot.scope: Explicit owner confirmation, current boot identity, verification and restore interlocks, no retry
manual_reboot.limitations: Mocked native request only; actual reboot and recovery unverified

legacy_vpn_retirement.scope: Disable startup of existing named PPTP/L2TP/N2N only; no provisioning, enabling, live reload or credential editing
legacy_vpn_retirement.limitations: Isolated mutation and rollback fixtures; actual UCI/browser/runtime pending

smb_startup.scope: Optional existing native SMB service startup disable only
smb_startup.limitations: Mocked init service only; no share provisioning, activation or actual service validation

remaining: integrate OEM navigation and legacy forms
legacy seven-day chart adaptation / persistent history policy
guest Wi-Fi activation without legacy network reload
